snippet.title: 【Release on November 21, 2025!】"ZAKO NO AHIRU" PV - High-Difficulty "Taunting" Climbing Action
snippet.description:
"ZAKO NO AHIRU" is a high-difficulty 2D platform action game where you control a peculiar duck while being taunted by the girl next door! Enjoy a challenging "mountain climbing" experience with simple controls!
